It looks like you are mixing up a few different concepts, blending Star Wars pop culture with real-world neurobiology and drug information! 
Here is the breakdown of what your phrase actually points to: 
  • Jabba the Ghabba (Jabba the Hutt): You are likely thinking of Jabba the Hutt, the infamous, slug-like alien crime lord from the Star Wars universe. He is known for his large, bloated appearance and his crime empire on the desert planet Tatooine. 
  • Ghabba Inhibitor (GABA Inhibitor): This is a slight misspelling of a GABA inhibitor (or GABA antagonist). In science, GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid) is the primary inhibitory neurotransmitter in your brain that calms down nerve activity. A GABA inhibitor blocks this calming effect, which actually increases brain excitability. 
  • Jellyneck (Jellinek): This appears to be a phonetic mix-up for Jellinek, a well-known Dutch organization that specializes in information, prevention, and treatment concerning alcohol, drugs, and addiction. Coincidentally, Jellinek provides extensive information on GHB, a drug that powerfully affects the brain's GABA receptors and causes a deeply sedating effect.
